notes.title: Major Demo Update: New Escape & Block Mechanics Are Here!
notes.content:
[h3][b]Hey champ![/b][/h3][h3]
A major update has just dropped for the [b]Boxing Machine VR[/b] demo — and it’s all thanks to you! 🥊[/h3][p][/p][p]During and since [b]Steam Next Fest[/b], we’ve received tons of amazing feedback from players. This update brings some of the most requested improvements to the [b]Rhythm Mode[/b]:[/p][p]🎮 [b]Reworked Escape & Block Mechanics:[/b]
Say goodbye to screen cues — now you’ll read the fight directly from the robot’s moves:[/p][list][*][p]When the glove turns [b]spiked[/b], it means [b]escape![/b][/p][/*][*][p]When it’s wrapped in rope, get ready to block![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45594341/af9a709fbce84418f74ec9a0a58aedd122736b58.png"][/img][/p][/*][/list][p]⚙️ [b]New Animations:[/b]
Stronger feedback, more fluid motions — every action now looks and feels better than ever.[/p][p]💥 [b]Eye-Pop Feature:[/b]
Land rapid punches and watch the robot’s eyes pop out! A small detail with big personality.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45594341/f65315bb53523909cf17befa1a5c19b5a517a037.png"][/img][/p][p]📽️ [b]New Trailer is Live![/b]
We’ve also released a brand new trailer featuring [b]all the robots[/b] you’ll face in the full game. Don’t miss it![/p][p]We're incredibly grateful for your support and feedback — keep it coming![/p][p][/p][p]🗓️ [b]Boxing Machine VR launches on August 29 — wishlist now and get ready to step into the ring![/b][/p]
